sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    px = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='b']
    return (min(p[0] for p in px), max(p[0] for p in px), min(p[1] for p in px), max(p[1] for p in px))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHT:", barpos(current_frame))
action(['DOWN']*3)
print("after DOWNx3:", barpos(current_frame))
r = last_action_result
print("res:", {k:r.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','game_over','reward')})
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("magenta rows 56-59 cols 38-46:", [a[rr][38:46] for rr in range(56,60)])
action(['SPACE'])
r = last_action_result
print("after SPACE:", barpos(current_frame), {k:r.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
